Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body:
When Steely Tenacity (using qui) gets blocked, am I allowed to replace Steely Tenacity ...  when it is blocked/before combat takes place? at the end of the action?  .. and more importantly, can I replace it with the Steely Tenacity in my sshheap or do I have to draw a card from my library.

> Name: Steely Tenacity
> [TR:C]
> Cardtype: Action/Combat
> Cost: 1 blood
> Discipline: Animalism/Dominate/Quietus
> Requires an anarch. Do not replace until after this action. When you would replace this card, you may take this card from your ash heap instead.
> [ani] [COMBAT] Strike: hand strike or use a melee weapon strike. This strike is at +1 damage, with an optional press.
> [dom] [ACTION]  Bleed at +1 bleed.
> [qui] [ACTION] +1 stealth action.  Enter combat with a ready minion.
>

Messages.Author: Rémi
Messages.Body:
Hey,

If the action is blocked, you go the combat sequence.
That combat belong to the action so you will not replace the card before the combat ends. It is the same as  Bum's Rush .

When you replace the card, you will have to choose between drawing from your Library o taking back this card from your ash heap.

Regards,

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
It's all written on it.

You don't replace the card "until after this action" (being blocked or not doesn't change a thing, it's not part of the action resolution).

> extrala wrote:
> when it is blocked/before combat takes place? at the end of the action?
>
The latter.

> extrala wrote:
> .. and more importantly, can I replace it with the Steely Tenacity in my sshheap or do I have to draw a card from my library.
>
Blocked or not, the card is in the ashheap upon resolution (=> successful or not). Steely Tenacity allows you to get back the card of the ash heap instead of drawing back.

"When you would replace this card, you may take this card from your ash heap instead."
